record.notes: Launched by Prime Minister Mark Carney on 4 June 2026 (Prime Minister's news release of 4 June 2026; ISED news release of 5 June 2026); the strategy page was last modified on 8 June 2026. The Prime Minister's release says that over the next five years the strategy will introduce new legislation, investments and programs. It draws on national consultations in 2025, with more than 11,000 submissions, and a 28-member AI Strategy Task Force. Its legislative commitments concern consumer privacy legislation, online safety laws (including legal tools against deepfakes and for safe chatbot interactions) and the continued review of the Privacy Act. Further measures include applied AI research and testing with law enforcement and security agencies for fraud prevention, cyber defence and threat detection, a National AI Literacy Initiative, and, under the Canada-Germany Sovereign Technology Alliance launched in February 2026, shared AI evaluation standards and benchmarks. The government says it will review and update the plan.
